mapper.sql: c.cinema_id AS cinemaId, c.city_id AS cityId, c.name, c.address, c.lat, c.lng, c.traffic_note AS trafficNote, c.tags_json AS tagsJson, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.updated_at AS updatedAt
6371000 * ACOS(COS(RADIANS(#{lat})) * COS(RADIANS(c.lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c.lng) - RADIANS(#{lng})) + SIN(RADIANS(#{lat})) * SIN(RADIANS(c.lat)))

SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM cinema WHERE cinema_id = #{cinemaId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cinema (cinema_id, city_id, name, address, lat, lng, traffic_note, tags_json, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{cinemaId}, #{cityId}, #{name}, #{address}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{trafficNote}, #{tagsJson}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
